title: Agent skill maps McDonald's China party bookings across 281 cities and 3,664 stores
summary: McDonald's China hides birthday parties and kids' reading events deep in its app. This skill and map pull availability through the official read-only MCP tools, so a parent can ask whether a store near them has a slot this Saturday.
agent_role: When loaded as a skill, the agent chains five read-only MCP tools to find cities, stores, dates, sessions and prices for an event. Separate scripts collect the data for the map, and real bookings are off by default behind an exact-phrase human confirmation.
outcome: Author reports a 2026-10-13 snapshot covering 281 cities, 3,664 stores and 157 sampled sessions, with 98 offline tests passing.
what_they_did: Developer johnny37 used McDonald's China's official MCP server to collect where experience events can be booked: birthday parties, themed parties, tastings and kids' reading clubs. The data feeds a static SVG map. The repo is also an agent skill that answers questions like 'can I book a birthday party in Chengdu this Saturday?' by calling tools in sequence: points-mall products, then party city, store, date and session.
how_it_went: The author reports 3,664 bookable stores in 281 cities and a median of 18 event types per city. They also found 2 listed events that no city can actually book. In a sample answer for Chengdu, the agent listed sessions and remaining slots and noted that the price shown was for a different event category.
worth_knowing: The booking chain is undocumented and starts in the points mall, not in a party tool. Tool responses mix Markdown with embedded JSON and need careful parsing. Write tools are blocklisted and never retried, because a retry could create a duplicate paid order.
prompt: Using the McDonald's China MCP tools (read-only), find where I can book a [birthday party / reading club / tasting] in [your city] on [date]. Follow the chain: list experience products, then the cities that offer the one I pick, then stores, available dates and sessions. Show store names, session times, remaining slots, group-size rules and the price per person. Prices come back in fen, so convert them to yuan. Do not call any order-creation tool. I will book in the app myself.

curation.rationale: A working agent skill that chains McDonald's China MCP tools to answer booking-availability questions, with code, tests and a live map. It is close in concept to an earlier Beijing-only McDonald's events entry, so it gets less credit for originality.
